findings.evidence: en.ts:58 `expiryDays: "Expires in {days} days"`, en.ts:107 `attentionUnitDays: "{count} days"`; usage.ts:44-45 `case "days": return { key: "expiryDays", values: { days: state.days } };` and NeedsAttentionPanel.tsx:33 `if (item.unit === "days") return format("attentionUnitDays", { count: item.count });` are used for every count, including 1.
findings.why_it_matters: Adjudicated LOW, fix now recommended. The tester is right and the defect sits exactly in the expiring-soon scenario the widget exists for (7, 3, 2, 1 days left), so English users see 'Expires in 1 days' and a '1 days' badge. Vietnamese has no plural so it is unaffected, and Vietnamese is the provider's default locale, which is why it is not MEDIUM. Behaviour is otherwise correct (0 -> 'Expires today', negative -> 'Expired', null -> 'No expiry date', attention clamps at 0).
findings.required_action: Optional but cheap: add singular keys (expiryDay, attentionUnitDay) in en and vi (vi value identical to the plural), and choose the key by `days === 1` in expiryMessage and NeedsAttentionPanel.countText; the typed catalogs will force the vi key.

findings.why_it_matters: Adjudicated LOW, no fix required for this gate. host.ts:3-5 and HostDashboardResponse (host.ts:125-138) declare every section as non-optional and the doc comment promises each section is always emitted with status OK/ERROR/FORBIDDEN, so a missing section is a contract violation that TypeScript already forbids; the Phase 4/5 request layer is not changed here. Residual risk is rollout skew only (web deployed against an older backend that lacks a section): the page would fall to the route error boundary instead of hiding one widget. The unknown-status handling is also inconsistent between sectionAvailability (hidden) and SectionPanel (error panel), but the union type excludes it.
findings.required_action: Optional hardening, cheap: make sectionAvailability/sectionData accept `undefined` (treated as forbidden) and read sections through them (or optional chaining on the three destructures); align SectionPanel with sectionAvailability for unknown statuses. Do not add runtime validation in the feature layer; that belongs to @pte/api-client if wanted.

The hooks listed in the location do not invalidate it although they change numbers shown (unassigned/active learners, session status counts and upcoming list, open tickets, active classes).
findings.why_it_matters: Adjudicated LOW, accept for this gate. The phase's Design Constraint and Risks name only import learners, create class and create session, and all of them (plus the add-student and workflow variants) invalidate on success only, with one shared key, covered by invalidation.test.ts (success and failure per hook). The remaining mutations are bounded by staleTime 30 s (api.ts HOST_DASHBOARD_STALE_TIME_MS), after which refetch-on-mount applies; the worst case is a briefly stale count when the user returns within 30 s, for example after assigning learners from the 'Assign learners' link.
findings.required_action: Optional follow-up: add the same one-line invalidation to the session open/close/cancel, class assign/unassign/transfer and suspend/reactivate hooks, or accept the 30 s staleness and record it as a non-goal. If done, consider one helper next to HOST_DASHBOARD_QUERY_KEY (see QUAL-012).

findings.evidence: DOM order is attention, kpis, usage, trend, upcoming, activity, status, split, grading, compact, but slots are reordered with `md:order-N xl:order-N` (attention `md:order-3 xl:order-5`, kpis `md:order-1 ... xl:order-1`, trend `xl:order-2`, usage `xl:order-3`, upcoming `xl:order-4`).
findings.why_it_matters: Mobile order is as specified (needs attention first, single column) and the md/xl grids pack without holes (xl rows: 12 / 8+4 / 8+4 / 4+4+4 / 6+6). On md and xl, however, keyboard and screen-reader order follows the DOM, so Tab goes from the quick actions to the needs-attention links, which sit in the third row visually, before the KPI section at the top. This is a known trade-off of CSS order (WCAG 2.4.3 / 1.3.2) and is the price of the 'attention first on mobile' requirement; every link stays reachable.
findings.required_action: None required for this gate. Verify the focus sequence in the Phase 9 keyboard pass; if it feels wrong, either accept as designed or give attention the same position on all breakpoints.

findings.evidence: Section retry passes `onRetry` straight to DashboardPanel with no pending state while the single query refetches (refetch cancels and restarts on every click); UsagePanel's half-failure uses a bare `<ErrorState .../>` whereas DashboardPanel wraps its error in `role="alert"`; quick actions are `<Button onClick={() => router.push(...)}>` (decided in the plan Preflight because Button is a plain button); links are hand-styled `text-xs font-semibold text-action hover:underline`.

verification_notes.standards: Route page.tsx is 5 lines with no 'use client' and no text, default export without return type like every sibling page. 'use client' lives in HostDashboardView/Grid/panels/hook/api. TanStack Query only in features/hostDashboard/api.ts (grep: getHostDashboard and useHostDashboard are used nowhere else; panels never call useQuery/useMutation). Errors: whole-page via getUserFacingApiErrorMessage(error, messages.errorDescription) with a fixed fallback; sections show fixed catalog copy. No any, @ts-ignore, @ts-expect-error, eslint-disable, style=, hex/rgb, arbitrary px spacing (grep). `text-[var(--ink-*)]` tokens match the repo convention (139 uses outside this feature, and @pte/ui itself). Shared UI used as shipped (PageHeader, DashboardPanel, CollapsibleSection, StatCard with the delta props, ActivityList with the renderLink adapter, TrendBarChart, StatusDonutChart, DataTable with search/pagination/filtering off, ProgressBar, Alert, ErrorState); the hand-styled link classes are the repo's own pattern (SessionTable) because no shared text link exists; accessibilityLayer={false} is still present at TrendBarChart.tsx:52 and TrendLineChart.tsx:108. Typed catalogs: HOST_DASHBOARD_VI is declared as HostDashboardMessages = Record<keyof typeof HOST_DASHBOARD_EN, string>, so a missing vi key fails typecheck; status and plan-type key maps are Record/satisfies over the api-client unions. LocaleProvider is not touched (no hostDashboard string in packages/ui). Org labels via useOrgLabels + pluralize. File sizes: largest source file messages/en.ts 195 lines (vi 189, constants 164), largest test invalidation.test.ts 208; no component function over ~65 lines.
verification_notes.correctness: One request: single useHostDashboard in HostDashboardView; key ['hostDashboard'] (constants.ts:7), staleTime 30_000, retry false, no windowDays sent; layout/other code never calls the endpoint. Retry for ERROR sections and the header buttons all call the same refetch (onRetry prop). FORBIDDEN returns null (SectionPanel.tsx:38, UsagePanel.tsx:26, KpiRow card drop, attention drop). Zero shows formatted 0; null or NaN changePct gives a dash with a sr label and flat/neutral; decrease is neutral (never bad) and the direction label is text. Seat warning uses the rounded percent (Math.round) so it agrees with the label; threshold 90; limit 0 shows an explanation, no NaN; over capacity clamps the bar and remaining. Expiry: none/expired/today/N days (plural bug QUAL-001). Dates and the 12-month series use meta.zone (Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh) with an Intl fallback for an invalid zone, month labels in UTC, partial month labelled via partialLabel. Upcoming: 5 columns, no Branch, capacity null shows a dash, links to /host/exams/{publicId}. Attention is derived only from OK sources, failed sources are counted for the partial note, forbidden ones are silent. Billing card is a count plus /host/orders link. Activity: actor is only Staff member or System (nil/empty id), unknown action codes use the generic label, hasOwnProperty guard against prototype keys. Every href is a constant route that exists under app/(dashboard)/host (students, exams, exams/[publicId], exam-staff, programs, billing, subscriptions, orders, support-tickets, audit-log). LearnersOverview is the last child of HostDashboardView, mounted unconditionally (no wrapper) and its files carry the pre-phase timestamp 2026-10-12 15:29 like the rest of examoperations/components; vitest.config.ts has the same timestamp, i.e. unchanged. Query cache is cleared at logout (providers.tsx:17, DashboardChrome.tsx:198), so a tenant-scoped key is not needed.
